description: Find local businesses on the East Coast, the West Coast, the Gulf Coast, Alaska and Hawaii (Alabama, Alaska, California, Connecticut, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Mississippi, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Vermont, Virginia and Washington) by trade, problem, name and place, nearest first. Understands problems as the trade that fixes them ('no heat' = HVAC, 'overflowing toilet' = plumbers, 'car won't start' = towing). Returns 20 results a page with phone, address, website, open-now status when the hours are known, whether a contractor's state license was verified, and the TownIndex page url.

emergency_now.description: Only businesses taking emergency calls right now (24/7 emergency service or on call). If none is known, all matches are returned instead, with fallback set.

near_zip.description: The user's ZIP code: used to rank by distance when the query names no place.

open_now.description: Only businesses open right now (by their hours, their emergency hours, or on call). If none is known to be open, all matches are returned instead, with fallback set.

query.description: What and where in plain words: a trade, a problem or a business name, and a town or ZIP code. Examples: 'plumber in Wolcott', 'no heat 06114', 'pizza Hartford', 'locksmith Worcester MA'.

name: search_businesses
title: Search local businesses
